analysis: This PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The patch adds one table row at about line 1751, documenting the env var DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES. That variable is forwarded to the launchd daemon and is implemented in AdmissionRateEstimators.swift (DeadlineAdmissionFixes.environmentKey). The supplied units (head lines 1-830) contain the surrounding unchanged prose. The added row itself is not in the supplied head excerpt, so I could not cite it or confirm its exact wording. The change is documentation only, with no code, config, auth, crypto or protocol modification. Review against the threat model: T-041 (prefix cache, TTFT timing oracle) is the nearest. An admission-fix toggle concerns deadline and admission rate estimation, not cache hit/miss behavior. It does not touch cache scoping, TTL, HMAC lookup tags or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, so I see no change to the accepted SEC-035 posture. Forwarding an operator-set env var into launchd is local operator configuration. The operator is already inside the TB-003 trust model, so it adds no new consumer-reachable surface. One open question for integration: the behavior of DeadlineAdmissionFixes is outside the supplied evidence. If the toggle alters admission or timing in a way a consumer can observe, that could interact with the T-041 timing channel or T-010 and T-029 availability. No such effect is shown. The existing text on logout, switch, cache and GLM docs is unchanged, and I make no claim about it. No findings.
